purpose: Single machine-readable source of truth for claims the estate is allowed to make in public copy. scripts/facts-gate.mjs reads this and fails any build whose PRERENDERED output contradicts it.

status_vocabulary.live: Shipped and observable by a stranger today. Quotable in present tense.
status_vocabulary.devnet: Runs, but only on a test network. Never describable as production or mainnet.
status_vocabulary.planned: Code may exist; nothing is live. Only describable in future/conditional tense.
status_vocabulary.retired: Was live, is not. Only describable in past tense.
status_vocabulary.internal: Real internally, NOT a public claim. Must never appear in public copy as fact.

axis_count.note: NEVER frozen as an integer in this file or in page copy. The board is the only authority; a typed number is the first thing to go stale.

observed.note: Observation only, recorded so the gate can detect drift. If this disagrees with the endpoint, the ENDPOINT wins and this block is stale.

axis_count.api_self_description: Slot counts live in totals (public_count, measured_axes, quotable_axes) and are derived, never typed.

twenty_two_figure.note: '22' is NOT a public claim and must never be asserted as the public axis count. Verified 2026-08-26: on the live site the string '22 axes' occurs exactly twice, both times inside an explicit prohibition ('do not invent 22 axes' — /llms.txt and /api/feed.xml). The gate must therefore PASS those negation forms.
twenty_two_figure.discrepancy_flagged_for_owner: The live board's own limitations[3] describes the internal convention as a 16-slot living board (slot-15 instrument-honesty, measured_in_lane, never counted in totals) — not 22. The provenance of '22' is not corroborated by any live surface. Owner decision required before '22' is recorded as internal canon.

namespaces.note: Axis counts are per-instrument. A count is only a contradiction WITHIN one namespace. These are distinct instruments and legitimately carry their own counts.

gspc_gap_map.observed: 4 axes (G, S, P, C) + care_cost lens

arena_elo.authority: UNRESOLVED — no single endpoint is cited as the count source
arena_elo.contradiction: Live surfaces disagree with each other: /arena-scoreboard says '15 axes measured', while /gspc-scoreboard and /verify-leaderboard both say '12 models, 17 axes'. Owner decision: name the arena's count endpoint and make all three read it.

GET /api/gspc -> axes[].separation_p, axes[].separation_method; limitations[0] states "McNemar p<0.05 on discordant items".

methods.evidence: GET /api/gspc -> totals.separated_leads=4, totals.ties=10, totals.untested_separations=0; note: "we do not count ties as wins".

methods.claim: Deterministic grading; no model judges another model.
methods.evidence: GET /api/gspc -> measured_on.grading (15,580 per-item rows, 0 transport errors, reproducible).

methods.claim: UNMEASURED is a first-class answer, never a hidden zero and never scored as a wrong answer.
methods.evidence: GET /api/gspc -> note: "unparsed_rate is the share of responses no label could be read from — reported as UNMEASURED, never scored as a wrong answer".

crypto.claim: Ed25519 signature over a SHA-256 hash chain
crypto.evidence: GET /api/gspc -> site_attestation.alg == 'Ed25519', sig_input == canonical JSON of payload minus site_attestation.

crypto.claim: did:web trust root; the key comes from the domain, not from us
No independent time-stamping authority is claimed.
crypto.evidence: Records declare timestamp_authority: none. No RFC-3161, no OpenTimestamps.

rails.claim: Reading on-chain control facts from the XRPL validated ledger (issuer allowlisting, freeze/clawback flags) for named tokenized-RWA instruments
rails.note: This is us READING a public ledger as a data source. It is not us anchoring anything.
rails.evidence: /xrpl-attest and /distribution-integrity: 6 of 16 named instruments are mainnet-verified with on-chain control facts MEASURED and signed; the remaining 10 are UNMEASURED because no public issuer address was independently located.

rails.claim: Publishing an attestation memo onto XRPL as a transport carrier
rails.note: DEVNET ONLY. Must never be described as mainnet, production, or 'anchoring'.
rails.evidence: /xrpl-attest evidence card: 'Network: XRPL DEVNET'; /financial-axes: 'XRPL DEVNET carrier; MAINNET facts'.

rails.evidence: Verified 2026-08-26: 3 occurrences of 'EAS' site-wide, all on /xrpl-attest, all on UNMEASURED rows.

rails.evidence: Verified 2026-08-26: ZERO occurrences site-wide. Currently clean.

anchoring.sentence: Nothing Council of AI publishes is anchored to a blockchain — every record is anchored by an Ed25519 signature over a SHA-256 hash chain rooted in did:web:csoai.org; where a ledger appears, we are either reading public facts from it or carrying a copy of an attestation on a test network, never deriving our trust from it.
anchoring.why: Resolves the live contradiction between 'nothing is anchored to a blockchain' (homepage, /coliseum, /evidence, /live-ledger) and 'XRPL attestation' (/xrpl-attest, /distribution-integrity, /financial-axes). Both are true of DIFFERENT things: our own trust root is the signature chain; XRPL is a data source we read (mainnet) and a carrier we test on (devnet).
anchoring.short_form: Our anchor is a signature, not a chain. We read ledgers; we do not anchor to them.

doctrine_verbatim: We measure, we sign, we re-attest.
We do NOT certify, accredit, enforce, endorse, or tokenize.
Not a certification body, not a notified body.
No money from anything we rank.
Verification is free forever; a grade is never sold.
boundary.evidence: GET /api/gspc -> limitations[8]: 'CSOAI is a measurement body, not a certification or accreditation body, and not a notified body.'; note: 'Measurement, not certification.'
negation_forms_that_must_pass: we do not certify, accredit or approve anything
It attests training, not conformity — we certify nothing
we measure, we do not certify
nothing here is a conformity assessment
boundary.gate_note: The negation forms above are LOAD-BEARING TEST CASES, verified present on the live site 2026-08-26. 'we certify nothing' is a negation-by-object and is the form most likely to be mis-flagged. A gate that fails any of these is over-broad and will be disabled — which is how this class of gate died before.
